I’m sure you’ve heard the concerned DDS whispering about Rodrigo Duterte’s supposed failing health.

Well, no need to panic. According to his son — the ever-reliable, party-loving Pulong — the old man is busy urging the military and the PNP to “save the Philippines” to coincide with the 3-day rally from the Duterte's true allies, the INC.

If anything, that tells me he’s nowhere near physically unwell. Mentally? Well, that’s a different diagnosis altogether and, perhaps, a story for another day.
